overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the Summerlin South Little League baseball team of Nevada on winning the 2025 Little League World Series United States Championship on August 23, 2025, by beating Fairfield National Little League 8 to 2. It notes this was the team's first trip to the Little League World Series in Williamsport, Pennsylvania, and only the second U.S. championship for a Nevada team. It recognizes the players, coaches, parents and league staff, and asks that copies be sent to the league's president and manager. The Senate agreed to it by unanimous consent on October 16, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution rightly honors the hard work and teamwork of young athletes and the families and volunteers who supported them.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
